column1: 4.5.18 FDR Rack. Fault Diagnostic Rack consists of test instruments used during
maintenance and diagnosing faults in system. These units are mounted on standard hard
mount/slides. FDR RACK mounting locations along with seating arrangements &
foundations shall be prepared as per Annex - H & I of the installation manual. The Test
instruments must be moved separately and carefully to compartment. The following Test
instruments and LRUs are the part of FDR Rack.
